interventions.detail: Use Python 3.11: pandas<2.0.0 (required by t5) has no py3.12 wheel and fails to build
numpy<2 for binary compatibility with pandas 1.5.3
tensorflow==2.15.1 / tensorflow-text==2.15.0 because mesh-tensorflow needs tf.compat.v1.estimator (removed in TF>=2.16)
setuptools<81 so tensorflow_hub can import pkg_resources
sentencepiece==0.2.0 and tensorflow-metadata==1.15.0 so they are compatible with protobuf<5, which TF 2.15 requires
Install torch (CPU wheel) separately; it is not in the t5[gcp] install_requires
hf_model.py predict(): append EOS to encoded inputs; without it t5-base produces garbage predictions
